# Remotion Upgrade

The upgrade procedure for Remotion projects — and the one Remotion skill that reaches beyond its own project at use time: npx remotion upgrade updates Remotion, its @remotion/* packages and the project-local Remotion skills together; the manual fallback aligns every Remotion dependency and auxiliary package (zod, mediabunny, @huggingface/transformers) to one version, updates the lockfile, and runs npx skills update across all twelve installed Remotion skills. Installing this listing only copies its 3 files and changes nothing; the upgrades happen only when the user runs the procedure on their own project. No licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing. Curated by Skill Harbor — Remotion Upgrade, by @remotion-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
